ENT
 

We can help you advance your knowledge and skills

text.text:
Your ENT medical education partner

At Stryker, we strive to deliver world class education and experiences that allow healthcare professionals like you to safely and effectively use our products. We accomplish this with a diverse mix of programs to fit a variety of needs. Our extensive medical education and training will help advance your product and procedural knowledge and skills to help drive better patient outcomes.

Tailored learning experiences

No matter where you are, no matter your surgical setting, we are here to support you.

Our medical education team is here to support you across your journey with our products. We provide extensive medical education and training for healthcare professionals that are designed to help advance product and procedural knowledge and skills.

standaloneimage.alt: STR ENT -- Supporting you with tailored learning experiences

text_copy.text:
Virtual events

Education from the comfort of home

Take advantage of our interactive, online sessions to expand your knowledge of contemporary ENT topics.

Action lab

Customized, local, hands-on training

Experience hands-on physician or resident training utilizing cadaveric specimen. This local lab experience introduces our technologies and products close to home.

Advanced sinonasal course

Hone your skills for better patient outcomes

Otolaryngologists experience hands-on cadaveric dissection, interactive lectures, and peer-led discussions during a weekend intensive educational course. A focus on traditional and hybrid endoscopic sinus surgery helps identify opportunities to incorporate minimally invasive technologies into practice.

Neurotechnology mobile lab

We meet you where you are

Our mobile operating room delivers world class training and education to you. Six integrated lab stations allow visitors to experience our full line of products and partner technologies. Our mobile lab criss-crosses the country with stops at facilities and institutions near you. We’re set up to accommodate a wide variety of surgical specialities, procedures and situations.

Resident bootcamp

Educational partnership from residency to retirement

Calling all senior otolaryngology residents to an action-packed educational weekend. Participate in faculty-led lectures and hand-on lab activities focused on rhinology, skull base and minimally invasive surgical techniques.

Speakers bureau

Peer-to-peer presentation and discussion

Hear expert perspectives on patient selection, clinical data and best practices surrounding the use of Stryker technologies.

Surgeon 2 surgeon

Visit a Stryker physician consultant in-clinic

An immersive in-person experience alongside a physician consultant. Observe cases and share best practices surrounding Stryker technologies.
